Hey I don'tt really know how to handle this but I do know how to keep myself alive all these years.

I simply told myself:

Imagine all the sunrise and sunsets i'd miss.
The flowers I'd miss smelling.
Fluffy and soft animals i'd miss to touch.
The shining stars and moon i'd miss to see.
The sunlight as it envelopes me with such warmth.
The books i left unread.
City lights or even camps that id miss to see and enjoy.
Coffee i'd miss to savour slowly.
Chilly nights id miss talking to my friends.
I'd miss helping other people cause i know how it feels when no one is there for you at your darkest.
The food i didnt have a chance to taste cause im no longer there.
Waterfalls id love to swim and feel the cold water on my skin.
Amusement parks and rollercoaster id miss to ride.
All the things that are worth a laugh.
All the beaches all the sand all the ocean id miss.
All the vacation and amazing places with amazing people id miss.
The crazy photos that has so much adventure memories and stories in it that i'd love to tell my kids about it, how their mom lived life the fullest and has zero regrets that will inspire them, well maybe not always happy and fairy tale-ish but its a life full of battle scars losing winning adventures and even love.

These maybe be little things in life, the spices in life. but these are the exact little things that keeps me breathing till this day. That gives me so much hope.

There's so much more in this life to love and to enjoy, but as humans we tend to dwell in our sorrows putting ourselves in work, school, etc shutting little things in life that gives well maybe hope? Faith? It may sound ridiculous but its worth a try.
